quarterly_data.signal: Disposal: Nidec's board resolved on October 01, 2026 to transfer all of its shares in Nidec Components Corporation (66,302,120 shares, 100% of voting rights; switches, trimmer potentiometers, pressure sensors, encoders, small precision motors, polygon mirrors and polygon scanner motors, fans and other electronic components for industrial equipment; Nidec says Nidec Components enjoys a largest-level share of the global external sales market of polygon mirrors) to TCG2603 Co., Ltd., a company indirectly owned by an investment fund related to The Carlyle Group; contract day October 01, 2026, transfer date December 1, 2026. Nidec Components' fiscal year ended March 2026: sales JPY 32,092 million, operating profit JPY 5,465 million. Nidec: the sale is part of the 'Re-Definition' business-portfolio reform to concentrate resources on core and high-growth areas; it is examining the impact on consolidated results.
